text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and Stock E for gains, but a gain versus my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each holding by its future prospects and role in my portfolio.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make me cling to losing positions and take profits too quickly; I should assess the whole portfolio consistently, without letting my purchase price dictate decisions.","I rarely trade, so I should keep decisions deliberate: use clear reasons and portfolio-risk limits for buying, selling, or holding rather than reacting to small monthly changes."]}
